name: Xiaqian Zheng
source:
The world has collapsed but I can't even remember how it began.

Wake up in the absurd wasteland, survive with a white-haired Narcolepsy girl. To run, to escape and head for unknown horizons.
Meet scavengers, robbers, lords, and the beauty traveling alone.
Experience completely different choices, exploring the truth of the deserted land.
And always take care...
Who are you beside me?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界已经崩溃了，但我什至不记得它是如何开始的。

在荒谬的荒原中醒来，与白发嗜睡症女孩一起生存。奔跑，逃离，奔向未知的地平线。
遇见拾荒者、强盗、领主和独自旅行的美女。
体验完全不同的选择，探索荒原的真相。
并且要时刻注意…
我身边的你是谁？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483350/]Steam[/url]]
